description: Get historical OHLCV price candles for a stock at daily, weekly or monthly resolution, for a period shorthand (1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 5Y or the full history) or an explicit from/to UNIX timestamp window. The default is one year of daily candles.

from.description: Start date as UNIX timestamp (overrides period)

period.description: Lookback period shorthand (default: "1Y"). Ignored if from/to are provided.

to.description: End date as UNIX timestamp (overrides period)

name: get_historical_prices
title: Get Historical Stock Prices
